announcements.headline: Conversion of Loan & Issue of Equity
announcements.insight: Shuka Minerals converts loans to equity following earlier assignments and subscriptions. This alters shareholding structure but lacks specific terms.

announcements.headline: Loan Conversion & Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director shareholding changes follow earlier loan conversions in September. This reflects ongoing capital structure adjustments rather than new strategic developments.

announcements.headline: Assignment of GMI Loan & Related Party Transaction
announcements.insight: Following August drilling updates, Shuka Minerals assigns GMI loans to investors and RAB Capital in September. This is followed by loan conversion and equity issuance.

announcements.headline: Further re Subscription
announcements.insight: Following August loan assignments and September conversions, this further subscription advances the capital raise sequence initiated earlier in the year.

announcements.headline: Assignment of £400,000 of GMI Loan to RAB Capital
announcements.insight: Shuka Minerals assigns £400,000 of its GMI Loan to RAB Capital. This follows a prior assignment of £800,000 and subsequent equity conversion, indicating ongoing debt restructuring.

announcements.headline: Conversion of Loan & Issue of Equity
announcements.insight: Shuka Minerals converts its GMI loan into equity, following the August assignment of that debt to investors. This alters the capital structure and dilutes existing shareholders.

announcements.headline: Assignment of £800,000 of GMI Loan to Investors
announcements.insight: Shuka Minerals assigns £800,000 of its GMI Loan to investors. This follows the earlier Subscription & GMI Loan Update in July.
